title: Sniffer's Life
description: New exotic and wild plants can now be found by the Sniffer. Discover each one and decorate your world
body:
Sniffer's Life is a datapack that brings to life all the missed potential of the Sniffer by introducing 20+ exotic and ancient plants for it to discover while digging. Instead of finding only two types of seeds, it can now uncover a wide variety of new plants, fruits and flowers that bring more life and variety to your world.Future updates will bring even more new features and mechanics.

Enjoy the project!
